cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
 project(dh2_physics_backend LANGUAGES CXX)
endif()
option(DH2_PHYSICS_BACKEND_BUILD_TESTS "Build standalone original-fixture full backend audit" OFF)
if(DH2_PHYSICS_BACKEND_BUILD_TESTS)
 add_executable(dh2_backend_audit tests/scene.cpp tests/host.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(dh2_backend_audit PRIVATE dh2_box2d_201)
 if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(dh2_backend_audit PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
 endif()
endif()
file(GLOB_RECURSE DH2_BOX2D_201_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/box2d-2.0.1/Source/*.cpp")
add_library(dh2_box2d_201 STATIC ${DH2_BOX2D_201_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(dh2_box2d_201 SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/box2d-2.0.1/Include")
target_compile_features(dh2_box2d_201 PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(dh2_box2d_201 PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
 target_compile_options(dh2_box2d_201 PRIVATE -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -include cstring)
endif()
